rows.role_title: رئيس هيئة البيعة — Chairman of the Allegiance Commission
rows.text: Article 15: the Commission is chaired by the eldest member among the sons of the founder King Abdulaziz, the next eldest of his brothers deputises for him, and if none of them is present the eldest member among the grandsons presides over the meeting.

rows.role_title: رئيس هيئة البيعة — Chairman of the Allegiance Commission
rows.text: Article 17: the chairman convenes the Commission in the cases of Articles 6, 11, 12 and 13; Article 18 requires a member who must be absent to notify the chairman in writing.
